title: Use Your Smart List
learningGoal: Understand how Smart Lists can support follow-up and contact management.

sections.title: What Smart Lists Help You Do

items.title: Find new leads quickly
items.description: Access recent leads without rebuilding filters

items.title: Review hot leads
items.description: Keep track of people close to buying

items.title: Find people who need follow-up
items.description: Identify contacts waiting for your response

items.title: Find contacts with no appointment
items.description: See who may need a booking reminder

items.title: Send targeted email follow-up
items.description: Reach specific groups with relevant messages

items.title: Send SMS follow-up
items.description: Text the right people at the right time

keyPoint: A Smart List should help you decide what to do next.

actionSteps.title: Open a saved Smart List
actionSteps.description: Navigate to your Smart Lists and open one

actionSteps.title: Review the contacts
actionSteps.description: See who appears in the list

actionSteps.title: Decide on action
actionSteps.description: What should happen next for these contacts?

actionSteps.title: Take action
actionSteps.description: Follow up, send messages, or book appointments

quizzes.question: What should you do after saving a Smart List?

options.option_text: Use it to take action, such as following up with leads, checking missing contact data, reviewing hot leads, or tracking appointments

quizzes.explanation: A Smart List is only valuable if you use it. The goal is to help you take action on the right contacts at the right time.
